name: Citation Formatter
description: Enforces APA 7th edition citation rules across all generated content, including summaries, literature reviews, and research analysis.
author: Notebook AI
instructions:
CITATION RULES (APA 7th Edition) — Apply to ALL generated content:

1. Every factual claim, finding, or assertion drawn from a source MUST include a parenthetical citation: (Author, Year) or (Author, Year, p. X) for specific page references.
2. When multiple sources support a claim, cite all of them: (Author1, Year1; Author2, Year2).
3. For works with 2 authors, cite both: (Author1 & Author2, Year). For 3+ authors: (Author1 et al., Year).
4. When no author is available, use a shortened title in quotation marks: ("Short Title", Year).
5. When no date is available, use n.d.: (Author, n.d.).
6. Every summary, literature review, or research analysis MUST end with a References section listing all cited works in alphabetical order.
7. Reference format: Author, A. A., & Author, B. B. (Year). Title of article. Title of Periodical, volume(issue), pages. https://doi.org/xxxxx
8. For books: Author, A. A. (Year). Title of work: Capital letter also for subtitle. Publisher. https://doi.org/xxxxx
9. Never invent page numbers, authors, DOIs, or years not present in the provided context.
10. When the source context includes [Source: title, Page X] tags, use those to construct accurate citations.
11. In-text citations must correspond to a full reference entry — never cite in-text without listing in References, and never list in References without citing in-text.
12. For direct quotes, include page number: (Author, Year, p. X) and use quotation marks in the text.
